name: Ephratah
overview: Ephratah, also called Ephrath, is the ancient name for Bethlehem in Judah, a location of significant biblical importance as the place where Rachel died and was buried (Genesis 35:16,19; 48:7). It is also the hometown from which the promised ruler of Israel, the Messiah, would come forth, highlighting its crucial role in God's redemptive plan (Micah 5:2). The name Ephratah is associated with blessing and legacy, as seen in Ruth where the elders pray for prosperity and honor in Ephratah, linking it to the heritage of Israel (Ruth 4:11). This small town, though humble in size, is deeply woven into the unfolding of God's covenant promises.
